title: Quantization guardrails: per-model per-layer profiles and calibration chains for INT8/FP8
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Naive global quantization (per-tensor min/max) for INT8 and FP8 leads to accuracy regressions on some open models (LLama-2, Mistral, Qwen) caused by small numbers of extreme activation outliers concentrated in a few layers (attention projections, feedforward intermediates, and residual paths). Goal: implement a robust calibration+validation workflow and model-specific per-layer profiles (guardrails) so that quantized builds meet quality SLOs without sacrificing unit-cost improvements.

Scope and deliverables:
- Calibration pipeline updates: add histogram-based and percentile-trimmed range estimators, per-channel symmetric/asymmetric quantization toggle, and optional bias correction pass for linear layers.
- Outlier detection: produce per-layer statistics (max, 99.9/99.99 percentiles, kurtosis) and flag layers with heavy tails for either clipping, layerwise rescaling, or high-precision fallback.
- Layer-wise scaling fixes: compute multiplicative scale factors to reduce dynamic range while preserving representational fidelity; store as a profile attached to model metadata in the model catalog.
- Model-specific rules: curate default profiles for LLama-2-7B/13B, several Mistral variants, and Qwen-7B/14B with documented rationale.
- CI & validation: add regression gates (perplexity delta, downstream task accuracy delta, and sample-by-sample mismatch threshold) to quantization CI.
- Rollout plan: staged deployment through dedicated internal test racks, Canary in Hosted, then promote to default INT8/FP8 profiles with telemetry.

Why different from prior tickets: focuses on building an operational guardrail layer (profiles + calibration chains + CI gates) rather than single-model mitigation experiments. Emphasis is on shipping reproducible profiles and integrating them into model onboarding and runtime fallback logic.
acceptance_criteria: Quantized model builds (INT8 and FP8) have <1.0% relative drop on MMLU/commonsense and <0.5 perplexity delta on PTB-like evals vs FP16 baseline for curated models when profile applied
Per-layer outlier detector produces stable flags across 3 calibration shards and triggers appropriate mitigation action in automated pipeline
Profiles are stored in model catalog and picked by runtime; runtime falls back to higher precision for flagged layers and logs telemetry
CI includes a deterministic regression test that blocks merges when a profile causes >1% downstream accuracy regression
Documentation (confluence) for creating a new model profile and running calibration end-to-end is published
implementation_steps: Extend calibration service to compute activation histograms and 99.9/99.99 percentiles per layer and per channel
Add percentile-trimmed min/max and an optional k-sigma clipping mode to quantizer
Implement layerwise multiplicative scaling transform and inverse in execution engine so quantized weights/activations stay numerically stable
Create model-profile schema (JSON) with fields: layer_flags, scale_factors, fallback_layers, recommended_quant_scheme
Run full calibration across benchmark set (10k sequences) for LLama-2-13B, Mistral-7B, Qwen-14B and store resulting profiles
Add CI job that applies profile to quantize a model and runs a small eval suite; fail on regression thresholds
Integrate profile selection into model catalog UI and runtime routing so Dedicated and Hosted use same profiles
Instrument telemetry for per-layer fallback counts and accuracy deltas for monitoring in Console
notes: Initial experiments (2026-02-20): naive per-tensor INT8 produced 2.4% accuracy drop on LLama-2-13B PR for closed-book QA. Using 99.995 percentile clipping + per-channel scales reduced to ~0.35% drop (Aisha).
Mistral variants show heavy tails in attention output projections; clipping alone increases token-level bias; layerwise multiplicative scaling preserved downstream accuracy better (Marina).

Qwen models showed sensitivity in RMSNorm residual magnitude — we should avoid aggressive symmetric clipping on post-norm activations and instead prefer small-scale rescaling + bias-correction (Liam).

We should avoid per-request runtime adjustments; profiles are computed offline and shipped with model metadata. Runtime can only select profile and enable layer fallbacks to avoid nondeterministic behavior.
Telemetry design discussion (2026-03-03): emit metrics quant.profile.applied, quant.layer.fallback.count, quant.eval.perf.delta and a per-model quantization report linked in Console (Simon).
comments: 2026-02-26 - Liam Chen: Spun up calibration job for LLama-2-13B using 8 shards of our standard calibration corpus. Found two layers with 4-6 orders of magnitude wider tails. Saved preliminary histograms to s3://redwood-calibration/ENG-13844/llama13b/.

2026-03-01 - Marina Kovac: Ran per-channel symmetric quant with 99.995 percentile trimming. Observed large reduction in max error but small bias introduced for certain classification prompts. I propose adding a lightweight bias-correction pass similar to post-training quant bias correction.

2026-03-04 - Aisha Patel: Decision meeting notes: adopt histogram-based estimator + percentile trimming as default; implement multiplicative per-layer scaling where histograms indicate >N dB dynamic range; fallback to fp16 for attention output layers if scaled quant still exceeds token-error threshold.
2026-03-08 - Engineering review: PR #2345 (github.com/redwood-inference/pr/2345) implements layer-scale storage and runtime selection. Needs integration tests for inference correctness before merge.

2026-03-12 - QA: Small eval suite results attached to Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/ENG-13844+calibration+results. LLama-13B INT8 with profile shows 0.28% MMLU delta, perplexity delta 0.22. Mistral7B still at 0.9% delta—we should tighten clipping thresholds or mark extra fallback layers.

2026-03-14 - Liam Chen: Updated CI to include quant regression job and added gating to block merges when downstream delta >1.0% on curated suite. Next: finalize profile UI and add rollout checklist for Hosted and Dedicated.
